Honeywell International Inc increased its stake in Merck & Co Inc (MRK) by 9.53% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Honeywell International Inc bought 60,400 shares as the company’s stock declined 4.63% with the market. The institutional investor held 694,100 shares of the health care company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $39.06 million, up from 633,700 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Honeywell International Inc who had been investing in Merck & Co Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $153.69 billion market cap company. (NYSE:MRK) has declined 14.94% since May 8, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 26.49% the S&P500.
